routes.description: List of routing rules mapping recipient domains to relay hosts

domain.description: Domain or wildcard pattern to match (e.g., example.com, *.example.com, or * for default)

relay.description: Hostname or IP address of the relay SMTP server

port.description: Optional port number for the relay (default: 25)

flags.description: Optional list of relay flags (e.g., 'auth' to enable authentication, 'ssl' for TLS)
